scope: 全局伏笔与回收台账：把主线、日常、副本、布林续篇、城镇回执与信任回访的‘埋下—回收’关系写成可校验清单；不新增承诺，不复制已有机器的重复内容，只做面向设计与制作的单一入口。

must_payoff.cn: 必须回收：已有实际机制（X边/桥/回执/回访）指向的伏笔。
must_payoff.en: Must pay off: plants with a concrete designed mechanism (X edge, bridge, receipt or callback).

reference.cn: 成组引用：续篇桥、城镇回执、受托解锁与听闻等按组登记，条目本身归各自所有者。
reference.en: Grouped references: continuation bridges, town receipts, entitlements and hearsay stay owned by their own registries.

deliberate_open.cn: 有意留白：作者层面不揭底、不用本地个案代替全局真相。
deliberate_open.en: Deliberately open: never resolved by local cases nor claimed as world truth.

threads.name_en: Two exits of the Bell-less Night
threads.guard_cn: 伊沃与被放走家属的出场按resolve_N1分流；先做后续章再回访同样只重评未来。
threads.guard_en: Ivo and the family appear per resolve_N1; doing later chapters first still only reevaluates the future.

threads.name_en: The returned name and the injury list
threads.guard_cn: 本人同意才公开姓名；死亡不补授权，事故记录仍可核。
threads.guard_en: Names go public only with consent; death grants nothing new while records remain checkable.

threads.guard_cn: 集体方法要求工组真实授权；个人信誉不能替代物证。
threads.guard_en: The collective route needs real crew consent; personal trust never replaces material proof.

threads.guard_cn: 买断/分期/转嫁分账；转嫁未补救留−1史，补救不回滚附录。
threads.guard_en: Buyout, instalments and shifting stay separate; unremedied shifting keeps its −1 history.

threads.guard_cn: 船位与卸货点各限本用途；不代替护理与路约。
threads.guard_en: Berth and drop point serve their own purposes only; neither replaces care or a road pact.

threads.guard_cn: 来源资格须物证核；不得宣称已见全库。
threads.guard_en: Source credentials need material checks; never claim the whole archive.

threads.name_en: The blank name in the quartermaster ledger
threads.guard_cn: 照护资源不得只照顾偏好一方；监督条款留库房复查项。
threads.guard_en: Care resources never favour one side; supervision keeps its unannounced inspections.

threads.guard_cn: 留营是正式解法；井水条款重谈而非玩家下命令。
threads.guard_en: Staying is a real solution; water terms are renegotiated, not decreed.

threads.guard_cn: 受害方代理先列问题；封存不是不问凯姆的理由。
threads.guard_en: Victim advocates set the questions first; sealing is no excuse to skip Kem.

threads.guard_cn: 莉德独立掌副本；旁人不得代她署名。
threads.guard_en: Lide holds copies independently; nobody signs in her stead.

threads.guard_cn: 交出藏身人写exchange_harm；trace/pay不清史。
threads.guard_en: Surrendering a hiding person writes exchange_harm; trace/pay never erase it.

threads.guard_cn: 人身与协作分开；neutral不入商队。
threads.guard_en: Person and cooperation stay separate; neutral never joins the caravan.

threads.guard_cn: 私了不给公共资格；迟来补监督须amendment。
threads.guard_en: Private settlement grants no public standing; late supervision needs an amendment.

threads.guard_cn: 工具与试走才算准备；不等于隔离已验证。
threads.guard_en: Tools and a walked route are preparation only, not verified containment.

threads.guard_cn: 回声不作历史或责任证据；维护费归属当真结算。
threads.guard_en: Echoes prove neither history nor fault; upkeep costs settle for real.

threads.name_en: The Well and the final confirmation
threads.guard_cn: 确认后冻结；招退守卫不等于赦免旧罪。
threads.guard_en: Freeze after confirmation; turning guards never pardons old crimes.

threads.name_en: Harbour clauses return to the hearing
threads.guard_cn: 公开/工组路线才成承诺；买断只救人。
threads.guard_en: Only public or guild routes become commitments; buyout merely saves people.

threads.guard_cn: 军管保留未补损失；报复路线无资格。
threads.guard_en: Military rule keeps losses unrepaid; retaliation earns no standing.

threads.name_en: The price of a sponsored bridge
threads.guard_cn: 桥能通而运输伤害仍在；不因赞助洗史。
threads.guard_en: The bridge may pass while transport harm stands; sponsorship never washes it.

threads.guard_cn: 留营不是失败；exclusive不复制再售同一原本。
threads.guard_en: Staying is no failure; exclusive never duplicates the same original.

threads.guard_cn: 公开既有责任才relief；patron保普通护理无公共资格。
threads.guard_en: Relief needs published existing liabilities; patron keeps care without public standing.

threads.guard_cn: 本人许可才迁；匿名不遭报复。
threads.guard_en: Relocation needs personal consent; anonymity braves no reprisal.

threads.guard_cn: 日常只改普通服务与回访，不重奖、不改N17、不上升全局资格。
threads.guard_en: Dailies change ordinary service and callbacks only; no re-reward, no N17 rewrite, no global standing.

threads.guard_cn: 副本只补可见线索与替代路径；随机条件不得封死出口。
threads.guard_en: Dungeons supply visible leads and alternate routes only; random conditions never seal the exit.

threads.guard_cn: 各桥条件、早/晚与缺席替代见续篇登记；旧314单方法回执另计，不合并。
threads.guard_en: Bridge conditions, timing and absence fallbacks live in the continuation registry; older single-method receipts stay separate.

threads.guard_cn: 受托解锁只作一次性回访伏笔，不越本人授权、不无限供物。
threads.guard_en: Entitlements are one-time callbacks; never override consent or grant endless stock.

threads.guard_cn: 听闻只改对话，不自动换算数字；本地仍按自身成果记档。
threads.guard_en: Hearsay alters dialogue only, never numbers; each town records its own verified deeds.

threads.name_cn: 主线成果入城回执十五处
threads.guard_cn: 回执只含公开核验范围；不展未授权名单，不二发奖励。
threads.guard_en: Receipts carry public scope only; no unapproved lists, no second rewards.

threads.name_en: The night boat's cargo and purpose
threads.rationale_cn: 原作未揭底；续篇只处理雅尼这一次租船与支款，不宣布国家阴谋或军船归属。
threads.rationale_en: Unresolved in the base game; the continuation handles only Yani's single charter, not state secrets.

threads.name_en: Responsibility for the old mayor's death
threads.rationale_cn: 官方2021背景未定责；城市篇不替作者裁定凶手或幕后。
threads.rationale_en: The 2021 official lore leaves it open; the city chapter never adjudicates whodunit.

threads.rationale_cn: 能力边界见[[晶石机制与叙事规则]]；结局只处理保管与责任，不解释宇宙本源。
threads.rationale_en: Ability limits live in the crystal rules; endings handle custody and liability, not cosmology.

threads.name_en: National politics and the three powers' summit
threads.rationale_cn: 地方代理不等于国策；不承诺政体更替或神器军队。
threads.rationale_en: Local agents are not state policy; no regime change or artifact army is promised.

threads.guard_cn: 条件回访只改未来回应：任务已结只追加新句，不回滚旧结与结算；本人缺席时旁人只可代述事前有限陈述。
threads.guard_en: Conditional callbacks change future replies only: resolved tasks get new lines, never rolled back; proxies speak pre-existing limited statements only.

threads.guard_cn: 原件／副件／残件分记；阅读只给信息，认领、销账、开闸、开门均须当事人点头。
threads.guard_en: Originals, copies and fragments are tracked separately; reading informs only - claiming, clearing debts, opening gates or doors needs the person present.

threads.guard_cn: 判定提示只写“看得出什么”，不含数值与掉落；观察不改变实际生成与判定。
threads.guard_en: Judgement hints describe what can be read, never numbers or drops; observations do not change spawning or checks.

threads.name_cn: 地点设计卡与地点清点
threads.guard_cn: 44处传闻地点全部有落点（28人物＋16迹象）；入口与安全回程只给可认锚点，不设自制传送。
threads.guard_en: All 44 rumored sites have a landing point (28 people, 16 signs); entries and safe returns name recognisable anchors, no custom teleports.
